name: almosafar-taxi
description: Almosafar Taxi — Next.js passenger, driver, and admin demo monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build -w @almosafar/shared && npm run build -w @almosafar/ui && npm run build -w @almosafar/demo-core && npm run build -w @almosafar/maps
scripts.test: npm run test -w @almosafar/shared && npm run test -w @almosafar/demo-core && npm run test -w @almosafar/maps
scripts.postinstall: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @almosafar/ui && npm run build -w @almosafar/demo-core && npm run build -w @almosafar/maps
